texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. Many factors determine your financial aid eligibility. TURNING IN YOUR DOCUMENTS DOES NOT GUARANTEE A FINANCIAL AID AWARD or DISBURSEMENT DATE!
texts.text: Many factors determine your financial aid eligibility. TURNING IN YOUR DOCUMENTS DOES NOT GUARANTEE A FINANCIAL AID AWARD or DISBURSEMENT DATE!

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2.  All  disbursement  dates  are  contingent  upon  funding  and  subject  to  change.  Grant  disbursements  are  based  on  your enrollment status and units will be checked approximately 2 weeks before each disbursement date.
texts.text: All  disbursement  dates  are  contingent  upon  funding  and  subject  to  change.  Grant  disbursements  are  based  on  your enrollment status and units will be checked approximately 2 weeks before each disbursement date.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. To receive your full disbursement amount you must be in attendance and your class must have already started.  Payment for  classes  that  start  after  the  first  day  of  the  semester  and  payment  for  classes  added  late  are  included  with  your  final disbursement of the semester.  If you have applied for a Direct Loan, you will be notified separately of your loan disbursement dates.

If you have applied for a Direct Loan, you will be notified separately of your loan disbursement dates.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4. If your Financial Aid staff has any questions or concerns regarding your paperwork, you will be notified via Web-Advisor under required documents as well as your student email or by phone.
texts.text: If your Financial Aid staff has any questions or concerns regarding your paperwork, you will be notified via Web-Advisor under required documents as well as your student email or by phone.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5. Once  we  have  received  all  initial  and/or  additional  documentation  requested,  your  Financial  Aid  staff  will  review  your paperwork and the reported information on your FAFSA to ensure accuracy.
texts.text: Once  we  have  received  all  initial  and/or  additional  documentation  requested,  your  Financial  Aid  staff  will  review  your paperwork and the reported information on your FAFSA to ensure accuracy.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6.  It  is  important  to  continue  to  check  WebAdvisor and student email to see if any additional/supporting documentation is required.
texts.text: It  is  important  to  continue  to  check  WebAdvisor and student email to see if any additional/supporting documentation is required.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7. Your Analyst will determine your eligibility by packaging and awarding your financial aid.  You will then receive a revised Financial Aid Award email notification via your student email account.
texts.text: Your Analyst will determine your eligibility by packaging and awarding your financial aid.  You will then receive a revised Financial Aid Award email notification via your student email account.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8. You  will  receive  your  disbursement  according  to  the  processing  deadline  you  meet.  Please  refer  to  the  reverse  for disbursement dates. DEADLINE DATES ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT WARNING.
texts.text: You  will  receive  your  disbursement  according  to  the  processing  deadline  you  meet.  Please  refer  to  the  reverse  for disbursement dates. DEADLINE DATES ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT WARNING.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 9. You will only be paid for classes you are actively attending. Remaining in all of your classes is critical to avoid repayment of funds received. If you receive payment for a class and drop, you may be required to repay a portion or the entire grant/ loan you received.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 10. Cal  Grant  and  Direct  Loan  Recipients  must  be  enrolled  at  least  half  time  (6  units)  and  must  have  an  active  academic program (major) other than undecided.  See Admissions and Records if updates are necessary.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Students will need to use the account number on the Higher One card to make a choice of activating the Higher One card, selecting the direct deposit option or requesting a check.  It is also important that your mailing address is current to avoid a delay in receiving your Financial Aid funds.
